build_cloth_simulation_model: build a Model instance with a learned graph network for static cloth simulation
build_graph_from_inputs: build a MultiGraph with normalized node and edge features from cloth simulation inputs
run_cloth_inference: run the Model on cloth inputs to predict new node positions via forward integration
compute_cloth_loss: compute the L2 loss on normalized target acceleration for training the cloth model
integrate_model_output: integrate per-node network output into new positions using the output normalizer inverse
